answer_4.quote: 1,065 annotators from 45 countries contributed to the labeling process, providing a wide range of perspectives on sexism.
answer_4.guideline: The dataset construction also aimed to mitigate different kinds of biases (i.e., seed, terminology, and temporal) through a careful selection of seed terms in both languages, random sampling across different time periods, and inclusion of diverse content sources.
